title: Can Google Searches Predict the Popularity and Harm of Psychoactive Agents?

_pre_registration.authority: Proposed by the agent and delegated by the maintainer, who gave explicit free rein rather than setting the numbers himself.
_pre_registration.why_this_matters: 08_REPLICATION_ENGINE.md: a tolerance chosen after seeing the result is not a tolerance. These bands and their full rationale were committed to git BEFORE any verdict was computed anywhere in this repository; that commit is the pre-registration record and it is checkable. Widening a band after seeing a verdict requires a new version of this file and is visible in history.

claims.notes: The paper reports 'correlation coefficient between the harm score ranking and the harm index was 81.6%', p=0.000143, alpha=0.01, n=16. The word 'ranking' reads as a rank correlation but is loose: recomputing from the paper's own Tables 1 and 3 gives Pearson r=0.8162 (matching) and Spearman rho=0.5668 (not matching). Registered as Pearson with a floor of 0.70 expressed as the interval [0.70, 1.0]. 0.70 is the conventional strong-correlation threshold, below the published 0.816 to allow drift, and above the ~0.62 needed for significance at n=16 under the authors' own alpha.

Spearman of the observed Pi ranking against the paper's published Table 1 ranking. Floor anchored in the paper's own data rather than convention: Table 2 gives Pi at six dates over 25 months, and the ranking's Spearman between first and last is 0.785 — how much the authors' own ranking moved against itself in two years. A 2014-to-2026 gap is roughly six times longer, so the floor sits meaningfully below 0.785.

_band_3_deliberately_absent.decision: not registered as a pass/fail claim
_band_3_deliberately_absent.reason: Table 2 shows the drift in individual Pi values across just 25 months of the authors' own study: GHB +567%, mephedrone +400%, cannabis +141%, khat +108%. A +-50% band would record 'deviates' for most substances within the paper's own study window, and a band wide enough for +567% would pass almost anything. By 08_REPLICATION_ENGINE.md's own standard there is no defensible tolerance here, and registering an indefensible one is worse than registering none.
_band_3_deliberately_absent.instead: The 32 published point values are retained as reference data in fixtures/jh2016/paper_reported.json and the observed deviation for each is reported as descriptive output, with no verdict attached.
